unqualified_search_registries.description: List of registries to search when an image name has no prefix (e.g., 'nginx' → tries 'docker.io/nginx', then 'quay.io/nginx'). Order determines priority.

insecure.description: Set to true to allow insecure (HTTP, self-signed TLS, or no TLS) connections. Disabled by default for security.

mirrors.description: List of mirror URLs to try *before* the main location. Mirrors should be full URLs (e.g., 'https://mirror.example.com/registry').

prefix.description: Optional prefix string to prepend to all image names for this registry (e.g., 'library/' so 'nginx' → 'prefix/nginx').

registries.description: Detailed per-registry configuration. Each entry defines behavior (mirrors, insecure access, prefix) for a specific registry location.
